ivy: quick heads-up: premerge SAST for auth-proxy skipped because scanner couldn't fetch artifacts (403). tagging @matt @olga.
matt: can you paste the CI log snippet?
ivy: snippet: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden {"error":"accessDenied", "serviceAccount":"scanner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"}
olga: we trimmed scanner-sa roles yesterday in PR 2199 (removed storage.objectViewer).
scan-bot: SAST run 6012 status=MISSING -> blocked merges for RC-2026-05-10.
ivy: product-security requested KMS decrypt audit for key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/build-key around 2026-05-10T12:00Z to prove no unwraps happened.
kms-bot: suggested query:
```
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.serviceName=\"cloudkms.googleapis.com\" AND protoPayload.methodName:Decrypt AND resource.labels.key_ring=\"ci\" AND timestamp>\"2026-05-10T11:30:00Z\"" --limit 100
```
matt: short-term plan: I'll add storage.objectViewer back via an auditable infra change, rerun SAST, then remove with a signed JIRA. Long-term: implement ephemeral KMS-wrapped tokens for scanner SA.
olga: I'll update the RBAC change playbook to include an automated scanner smoke test and add a presubmit rule to treat MISSING runs as FAIL.
ivy: filing INFSEC-2301 with CI logs and KMS query. marking release candidate unblocked after rerun. closing thread.
